Jerry mentioned three months ago when we were discussing the qualitative data gathered from our growth hack into local stores that it is a very very healthy sign that the sales cycle is extremely short (_in a matter of few minutes_) after presenting the call to action to venue operators who are value aligned versus infinitely long (_zero conversion_) when speaking to venue operators who are not-values aligned 

The cacao was invited into the two exclusive climate week gatherings where values aligned individuals were gathered
